# Steam Stickers APNG deft4j Timed Benchmark

This separate APNG-only report compares Columbo `--max` against the
timed `deft4j` references in `steam-stickers_apng`. These cases are
intentionally excluded from the main deft4j and PNG benchmarks.
The timeout is read from each reference filename, then two seconds are
added and the result is clamped to 10..180 seconds.
A state-carried regression receives up to two serial confirmation runs.
Only a retry that is no larger in either size metric is retained.

Prior-result regression annotations are state-local: they are created
only when a row replaces an older result in the same state file. A
fresh state has no prior-row baseline, so the annotation count below
does not replace the independent historical-state audit.

- completed cases: 2431
- misses: 0
- strict-policy misses reaching parity in relaxed audit: 0
- PNG preservation-policy differences: 0
- unresolved misses: 0
- errors: 0
- state-carried prior-result regression annotations over 10%: 42
- stale timeout rows: 0
- rows with recorded Columbo binary hash: 2431
- rows from current Columbo binary: 2431
- rows from older Columbo binaries: 0
- rows without Columbo binary hash: 0
- misses from current Columbo binary: 0
- misses from older Columbo binaries: 0
- misses without Columbo binary hash: 0

## Full-corpus Eligibility

This benchmark contains all 2431 paired APNG cases in the separate Steam stickers corpus.
The directory contains 2434 source files and 2431 physical timed deft4j references.
The following sources have no timed reference and are not eligible:

- `1016180_195796_4c7b474ed31cef51b7b39a4f625ad4f810300648.png`
- `1117380_103426_44f65c1abf1ac8e28c3c60eca250d7cb19ea6fdc.png`
- `978460_116226_b332556d506ea3790d0c4c3464521a34d5e86ce6.png`
